Let
\[
w=9z_1z_2+4z_1z_3+z_2z_3.
\]
Expanding \(|w|^2=w\overline w\) using \(|z_1|=1, |z_2|=2, |z_3|=3\):
\[
|w|^2=81|z_1|^2|z_2|^2+16|z_1|^2|z_3|^2+|z_2|^2|z_3|^2
+72\operatorname{Re}(z_1\overline{z_2}+z_1\overline{z_3}+z_2\overline{z_3}).
\]
Thus
\[
144=324+144+36+72S=504+72S,
\]
where
\[
S=\operatorname{Re}(z_1\overline{z_2}+z_1\overline{z_3}+z_2\overline{z_3}).
\]
So
\[
72S=-360 \implies S=-5.
\]
Now
\[
|z_1+z_2+z_3|^2=1+4+9+2S=14-10=4.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\boxed{2}.
\]
